entries.english: A specialized electrical weapon designed to be mounted on a turret.

A sophisticated explosive charge connected to a pressure plate trigger which detonates immediately on touch. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm.

A concealed high-tech trap that releases a localized EMP pulse when triggered. It resets automatically after a short cooldown. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm.
A small ammunition box that improves the reload speed of everyone nearby. Will explode if damaged.
Artillery launcher. Lobs bombs over walls. Accurate and long-ranged.
A ballistic device used to launch a projectile a great distance without the aid of gunpowder or other propellants.

A razor wire fence consisting of sharp edges and points arranged at intervals. Not only does it slow down movement of enemies, it also inflicts cuts and puncture wounds. Razor wire will block certain kinds of animals the same way that fences do.

Two heavy metal jaws held open under tension, connected to a pressure-sensitive trigger. When stepped on, the jaws snap shut with high force, inflicting severe damage. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. When triggered, it can be re-armed.

A row of sharpened spikes laid low across the ground. Designed to maim or cripple those who attempt to charge through, especially fast-moving animals or mounted units. Can be placed next to other cavalry spikes. Upon being triggered, cavalry spikes will need to be rebuilt.
A self-loading minigun designed to be attached to a turret.
A self-loading HMG designed to be attached to a turret.
A self-loading minigun designed to be attached to a turret.
A heavy, pulse-charged rapid-fire blaster mounted on a barricade to grant cover. Needs to be manned in order to fire. Requires plasteel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use.
A heavy machine gun mounted on sandbags to grant cover. Needs to be manned in order to fire. Requires steel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use.

A multi-barrel machine gun mounted on sandbags to grant cover and provide stability. Where most self-loading guns are powered by the energy from the gunpowder, the minigun uses an electric motor to rapidly cycle cartridges through the weapon. Needs to be manned in order to fire. Requires steel to refurbish its barrels after heavy use.

A retractable, waist-high barrier for use as cover from incoming shots. It provides strong cover while deployed and is almost invisible when submerged. Barricades will block certain kinds of animals the same way that fences do. Requires power.
Construct submersible barriers and turrets, perfect for indoor defenses.

entries.english:
An ultratech device that projects a potent energy field around itself to protect everything inside, but consumes a huge amount of power when active. Works through walls.

Repulsors only activate when there's an active threat present such as a raid or an artillery bombardment. Otherwise, they stay in an inactive state and consume much less power.

Can set surrounding area on fire if enough damage is absorbed in a short period of time.
How many times does this trap hit its targets.\n\nThe total trap damage is spread evenly across all the hits.

A long, damage-resistant reinforced trench. Crossing it requires climbing up and down, therefore it significantly slows down movement speed. People inside the trench suffer a weapon range penalty, but gain significant cover and protection from explosive damage.
this person is standing in a trench or other defensive structure.
A self-loading large-bore double cannon designed to be attached to a turret.
A self-loading minigun designed to be attached to a turret.

A specialized defensive turret that intercepts explosive projectiles and incoming drop pods within its protective radius, but cannot engage ground targets. Interception chance scales with the target's velocity. Requires steel to refurbish its barrels after heavy use.

An armored, portable automatic turret. Requires steel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use. Extra armor plating allows the turret to provide some cover, makes it more resistant to enemy fire and prevents explosion in case of severe damage. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.

A powerful, manned artillery cannon designed for long-range bombardment. Though it fires slower than a mortar, its improved targeting systems allow for far greater accuracy, making it ideal for precise strikes against enemy structures or high-value targets. Can be crewed by two people to double its firing speed. Capable of providing fire support across the world map, but only on revealed locations.

A twin-barreled variant of the autocannon turret. While less accurate and slightly shorter-ranged than its single-barreled cousin, it compensates with a high volume of fire. It cannot fire at close-up targets, and may explode when damaged.

An automated mortar that launches high-explosive shells. While it can inflict devastating damage, the mortar's inherent inaccuracy makes it more useful for attacking large fortifications than groups of enemies in the field. Due to a delicate firing mechanism, it's only calibrated to fire high-explosive shells.
An ancient military siege engine in the form of a crossbow mounted on a wooden construct. Bolts fired from this machine explode into splinters on impact. Needs to be manned in order to fire.

A ballistic device used to launch a projectile a great distance without the aid of gunpowder or other propellants. In use since ancient times, the catapult has proven to be one of the most persistently effective mechanisms in warfare.

A cutting-edge, pulse-charged, rail-assisted weapon system that fires a short burst of high-velocity projectiles, energized with unstable plasma as they leave the rail. The resulting shots pierce armor and bodies alike, but the turret requires new plasteel barrel after use. It cannot fire at close range, and may explode when damaged.

A portable automatic charged-shot turret. Pulse-charge technology charges each shot with unstable energy as it leaves the barrel. Requires plasteel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.

A compact automatic turret equipped with retractable armor plating and a submersion mechanism. It is capable of submerging into the ground, becoming impossible to target. Requires steel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.

A portable flamethrower turret, capable of spewing a cone of flame that engulfs enemies and terrain. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.

A refined turret with military-grade stabilization, targeting routines, and hardened casing. Requires steel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.

A heavy automatic turret. Its multi-barrel mechanism unleashes sustained fire at high speed, shredding lightly armored targets at mid-range. It may explode when damaged. Requires steel to refurbish its barrels after heavy use.
An apparatus combining an extremely luminous lamp and a mirrored parabolic reflector, useful for lighting up and dazzling targets.

A compact automatic turret fitted with a semi-automatic shotgun. Requires steel to refurbish its barrel after heavy use. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.

A cutting-edge utility turret designed to counter the mechanoid advances. Four capacitors are charged to release a bolt of electricity. Upon impact, the power surge stuns affected mechanoid, before seeking to jump to another. Will only target mechanoids.
Artillery cannot fire in this direction.
Artillery cannot fire from ground to ground
Artillery cannot fire from planet to space.
Artillery cannot fire from space to ground.
Artillery cannot fire from space to space.
Artillery needs to target a visible, explored map.
Deploy the structure from the submerged state.
Designate traps to be rearmed by colonists.
Set the target on the world map for the artillery to fire at. Shots fired over the world map are less accurate. Can only fire at revealed locations.
Submerge the structure into the ground, making it much harder for it to take damage.
